text:
Mika: hey team :wave: quick heads up — first day oncall for me and i'm blocked. i can log into the console but when i click the runbooks I get a 403. also don't see myself on the PagerDuty schedule. submitted the access form earlier but not sure who approves. pinging @raj for help
Raj: hey @Mika — welcome! i'll check perms. can you paste the exact 403 screenshot or the URL? also confirm you tried from corp VPN? sometimes SSO scoping blocks runbook access when off-vpn.
Mika: thanks @Raj — url is https://runbooks.redwood.ai/eng/oncall/incident-playbook (screenshot attached in thread) ; i'm on the work wifi and i tried the browser incognito window, same 403. PD schedule link (https://pagerduty.com/schedules/eng-oncall) shows me as "no access"
Raj: got it. i'm toggling the runbook ACLs now. one sec. if that doesn't land, i'll raise a manual approval with InfoSec. also i'll ping infra to check SSO groups.
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty — user Mika (mika@redwood.ai) added to request list for schedule "eng-oncall" (pending manual approval)
Sarah: hey @Mika — i'm your oncall buddy for this rotation, happy to pair. once Raj confirms perms we can run a 30m sim. i usually do a quick walkthrough of the major runbooks and the escalation paths. when are you free today/tomorrow?
Devon: FYI infra: there was a stale group mapping on the runbook server this morning, pushed a fix around 11:22. if you're still seeing 403 after a hard refresh, try clearing SSO cookies or `rm -rf ~/.cache/sso` then re-login. also you can verify your group membership with `id` on the bastion (if you have SSH access).
Raj: permissions updated for Mika — should be able to access runbooks now. @Mika try the link again and confirm. i also approved the PagerDuty add request, ops will finish the schedule join.
Mika: it's loading now! i can open the incident-playbook. thanks. i still don't see myself on PD schedule page though, it says "pending"
oncall-bot: PagerDuty — Mika has been added to schedule "eng-oncall" effective 2026-03-25 08:00 UTC. Please acknowledge when you see your oncall shifts.
Mika: saw it, thanks :thumbsup: can we also schedule the sim? would like to run a practice pager and a quick runbook walkthrough before the first real rotation.
Sarah: awesome. i'm free tomorrow 10:00am PT for a 30m sim. i'll cover alert triage, runbook nav, and a mock escalation. i'll drop a calendar invite.
Devon: i'll be on the sim too — i'll show how to check quota/capacity dashboards and how to read the root cause hints in logs. quick tip: in the playbook look for the "limited-capacity" section, it has the throttling mitigation steps.
Mika: perfect — appreciate it! also one tiny thing: my PD mobile push isn't coming through. any tips?
Raj: check that mobile push is enabled in your PD profile and that notifications aren't blocked by do-not-disturb on the phone. if push consistently fails, use the PD SMS fallback or call the backup. i'll also check org-level push configs.
Mika: got push after toggling notifications. all good. thanks everyone for the fast help. excited to shadow and learn. :star_struck:
